title: Self-Pay Visit Package Renewal Discount Rate Card
content:
**Rate card — renewal discount, Self-Pay Visit Package.** Each tier carries its own renewal discount percentage and renewal window, the window being counted in calendar days after the earlier package was exhausted.

| Tier | Renewal discount | Renewal window after exhaustion |
|---|---|---|
| Starter 4-Visit Package | 0 percent | 0 calendar days |
| Recovery 6-Visit Package | 5 percent | 30 calendar days |
| Core 8-Visit Package | 5 percent | 30 calendar days |
| Complete 12-Visit Package | 5 percent | 30 calendar days |
| Post-Surgical 18-Visit Package | 0 percent | 0 calendar days |
| Comprehensive 24-Visit Package | 10 percent | 30 calendar days |

Percentages are whole numbers. The Comprehensive 24-Visit Package carries the highest renewal discount, 10 percent; the Starter 4-Visit and Post-Surgical 18-Visit Packages carry 0 percent with a 0-day window.
